title: Enhancing Trustworthiness and Minimising Bias Issues in Leveraging Social Media Data for Disaster Management Response

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying and visualizing geographic sampling biases in datasets using tools like sampbias, and evaluating the representativeness of data using spatial sampling and synthetic minority over-sampling techniques (SMOTE).

Categorizing the language of social media posts (global, local, mixed) to identify demographic language disparities, and evaluating the use of Multilingual Large Language Models (MLLMs) and multilingual data collection as countermeasures.

Assessing the representation integrity of crisis-relevant training data and evaluating de-biasing techniques such as the Learning Fair Representation (LFR) algorithm and prejudice-free representations (PFR) to identify and remove discriminative features.
